summary: Armour Residential REIT, Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to announce guidance for its July 2026 monthly cash dividend of $0.24 per common share, with record date July 15, 2026 and payment date July 30, 2026. The filing includes a press release discussing that the dividend is in line with REIT tax distribution requirements. No extraordinary corporate events such as acquisitions, divestitures, or activist campaigns are mentioned. The filing is a routine dividend guidance update. As this is purely a routine dividend announcement, it does not constitute a special situation under any defined category.
